purpose: Give Claude every repository-resident input, rule, and command needed to regenerate the full candidate/frontier handoff and perform block-exact authoring.

critical_warning.interpretation: INVALID AS SAFETY EVIDENCE: fresh-world/entity-snapshot artefact
critical_warning.required_behavior: Do not certify Extraction balance until hostile exposure is measured or explicitly sensitivity-tested.

reproducible_run.note: The optimizer currently accepts a ZIP whose root contains data/. Build that ZIP from the committed export directory; do not alter the JSON inputs.

reference_run.metric_warning: balance_asymmetry is an internal normalized search measure, not a win probability or percent team advantage

authoring_contract.regional_first: Optimizer selects qualifying 128x128 regions and complete strategic portfolios; Claude selects exact blocks/clearings/pads/paths only after inspecting the realized terrain.
authoring_contract.renewables: Use species already observed in the selected ecological region. Do not sprinkle arbitrary animals into ecologically empty cells merely to satisfy balance.
authoring_contract.founder_stock: Carrot/potato founder patches may be authored introductions in qualifying farmable regions.
authoring_contract.worksites: Keep dormant Worksite candidates generic. Do not pre-bind them to Mining Site or Industrial Factory before activation.
authoring_contract.routes: Author physical path quality; do not implement an intrinsic movement-speed bonus.
authoring_contract.fallbacks: If exact terrain invalidates a regional finalist, return to another optimizer finalist rather than inventing an untested strategic placement.
authoring_contract.rescan: Every exact authored placement and Route must be rescanned. Replace regional reach proxies with measured exact-world values before freezing the map.
authoring_contract.combat: Combat outcome resolution is outside this balancing pass.

provenance.NON_CANON_FIXTURE: scenario count, threshold, or weight chosen only for analysis
provenance.UNRESOLVED: must remain missing until measured or explicitly sensitivity-tested
